jobs.prompt:
Create one finished full-body 2D character STYLE REVISION candidate for Memory Forge, a Korean subculture collectible RPG. EDIT TARGET is image 1: keep exactly that character's existing outfit version, all visible costume cuts, exposure, accessories, boots, pose, hand placements, silhouette and signature prop. Image 2 is an existing project design sheet for identity/prop structure checks, NOT permission to change image 1's outfit. This is a rendering/face-language redesign, not a costume redesign. Preserve the adult age, mature build, skin tone, hair color and eye color. Do not copy the old glossy rendering. Redraw deliberately as a cohesive hand-drawn illustration with the requested art direction. Single character, head to toe, complete shoes and full prop with margin; portrait 2:3 canvas approximately 1024x1536. Transparent background with clean alpha, no halo, no text, no layout, no inset portraits, no logo, no frame, no extra person. Same neutral soft upper-left light across every candidate, no rim-light bloom or bokeh. The character must still look like the same adult, not a child, doll or a different person. All fingers and prop contact must be coherent. Do not add random buckles, ornaments, weapons or loose straps. Preserve designed ornament placement while describing it with intentional line and value grouping.

SERA, adult woman age 24, 170cm slender adult proportions. Long SILVER-WHITE hair in a LOW PONYTAIL with the same brass clock/gear hair clip; AMBER eyes with a subtle clock-hand iris motif, not an oversized symbol. Calm, observant eyes, restrained almost-smile with dry wit; no open mouth, no blush or wink. Preserve image 1's OPEN NAVY LONG COAT with brass clockwork ornaments and clock motifs along the hem; BLACK full-length fitted BODYSUIT continuing over both legs; thigh holster, fingerless black gloves, brass fittings and black heeled boots. Keep the same long brass-and-dark sniper rifle angled down at her side, complete long barrel, scope, and clearly readable GLASS HOURGLASS CHAMBER with two connected bulbs. Her hands remain carefully checking the scope, eyes slightly lowered as in target. Long coat plus rifle is her identity. Preserve adult neck and jaw length while simplifying facial rendering; do not redesign her costume as a dress or shorts.

DIRECTION A: CRISP LINE-LED CEL ILLUSTRATION. Clear fine tapered dark-navy line art, selective thicker outer contour, controlled internal lines. Expressive graphic anime eye shapes with a clean upper eyelid and simple lower eyelid. Keep individual eye shape and adult jaw, not enormous rounded child eyes. Nose as one short fine mark plus tiny cast shadow only: no rendered nose bridge, no nostril modeling. Mouth as a short expressive line, no lipstick or modeled lip volume, no philtrum. Matte skin in flat warm ivory with ONE CLEAN HARD-EDGED SHADOW family plus tiny contact shadows; no skin gloss or gradient airbrushing. Hair as large well-designed locks, one hard-edged shadow family and a SINGLE BROAD GRAPHIC HIGHLIGHT BAND, no white noodle strands. Costume retains all existing motifs but shades by broad clean cel shapes; metal gets a few hard small light accents, cloth has broad flat shadows. Strong readable colors, no painted grain. This must be visibly clean cel animation/key-visual language, decisively less volumetric than the original.
